reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 14 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Kings (revenge).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 82 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 207 and 255 total points.
